settings.label: 01 / Intro
settings.text: Graphic designer and brand-new dad making *self-initiated,* alt and unapologetic work — motion, identity and type that moves.

items.title: Motion design
items.detail: Title sequences, product loops, social cutdowns and kinetic type systems.

items.title: Brand identity
items.detail: Marks, typography, colour and the rules that hold them together across every surface.

items.title: Campaign & art direction
items.detail: Concept to rollout — key visuals, OOH, print and the motion that ties it together.

items.title: Web & interactive
items.detail: Portfolio-grade sites and interactive pieces where the design is the interface.

items.title: Listen
items.text: A short call to understand the problem, the audience and what success looks like.

items.title: Frame
items.text: Direction boards and a clear plan — options narrowed before anything gets polished.

items.title: Make
items.text: Design and motion in tight rounds, shared early and often.

items.title: Ship
items.text: Final files, systems and handover so the work keeps going without me.
